tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Ivory on the main site; noir on Xarina Privé pages, invites and packaging.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, drawers, the cart and checkout panels that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Bands (Privé strip, trust strip) and image placeholders while photos load.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, the logo mark and wordmark on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, labels, helper text, hex notes. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, dividers, input borders at rest. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Champagne. Decorative accent: short rules under headings, Privé badges, countdown separators. Never small text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (Join the Waitlist, Buy Now). Champagne on Privé pages.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors and payment failures only. Sold Out is shown in ink-muted, not critical.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control or between countdown units.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gaps between related elements.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gutters, gaps between product cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside heroes and bands on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space between major homepage sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Buttons, product images, cards: Xarina is square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs and selects only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, the circular mark badge and colour swatches.
